limitations: Applies only to six-point supports of open neighborhoods in KG(13,3), not all orders, all coefficients or closed neighborhoods.
scientific_integrity: The exact dimension-six onset and one doubled-spoke construction were previously established and are not presented as novel. The new classification and count were derived independently and checked with two finite scripts. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Rigidity and exact count of six-point shattering supports in the smallest rank-three Kneser graph
